## Problem and behavior / 问题与行为

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. / 说明问题及修改后的行为。

## Verification / 验证

Tests, build, manual paths and hardware/OS coverage. / 检查、构建、实际路径及设备范围。

## Resource impact / 资源影响

Sampling, timers, retained memory, writes, dependencies or permissions affected. / 说明采样、定时器、内存、写盘、依赖或权限变化。
